note.alibaba_billing.balance_field_seman: AvailableBalance = MybankCreditAmount + CreditAmount; CreditAmount is the prepaid credit balance (positive), MybankCreditAmount is the bank-linked credit (positive or negative depending on usage).
note.alibaba_billing.bill_no_lines: The query returned no lines: the BSS does not emit billing lines for the supplied cycle (the cycle may still be settling or the account has no activity).
note.alibaba_billing.bill_not_requested: Monthly bill not queried: configure params.billing_cycle in YYYY-MM to add up the PreTaxAmount for the month. The BSS OpenAPI aggregates every product of the master account; without an explicit filter, we do not infer an 'AI only' scope.
note.alibaba_billing.bill_summary: QueryBill paginated {line_count} lines across up to {page_count} pages (TotalCount = {declared}). The BSS aggregates every product of the master account in cycle {cycle}; there is no 'Model Studio only' dimension — to separate AI, set ResourceId on the bill dimension or move to Cost Management. {source}.

note.alibaba_billing.endpoint_and_signin: Fixed BSS OpenAPI {endpoint} endpoint (BssOpenApi product, version {version}). RPC v1 HMAC-SHA1 signing: AccessKeyId and Signature travel in the form-body alongside the request; the AccessKey Secret is never sent in plain text. {source}.
